registry.example_item_tag_contract.title: Example Item Tag Contract

misc.craftoriotemplate.upgrade_hello_des: A demo manual (ActionUpgrade) upgrade. Sends "Hello" to every online player when unlocked.
misc.craftoriotemplate.upgrade_modifier_: Modifier: Multiplier
Targets ModifierTarget.MULTIPLIER (ADD 0.1) - adds directly to your overall points multiplier.
Modifier: Item Base Value
Targets ModifierTarget.ITEM_BASE_VALUE (MULTIPLY 0.1) - increases the base sink value of every item by 10%.
Modifier: Item Tag Base Value
Targets ModifierTarget.ITEM_TAG_BASE_VALUE (MULTIPLY 0.1) - increases the base sink value of items in the craftorio:copper tag by 10%.
Modifier: Contract Refresh Speed
Targets ModifierTarget.CONTRACT_REFRESH_SPEED (MULTIPLY 0.1) - speeds up how quickly new contract offers refresh.
Modifier: Effect Timer Speed
Targets ModifierTarget.EFFECT_TIMER_SPEED (MULTIPLY 0.1) - speeds up the passive random effect timer.
Modifier: Punishment Duration
Targets ModifierTarget.PUNISHMENT_EFFECT_DURATION (MULTIPLY -0.1) - shortens punishment effects granted by failed contracts by 10%.
Modifier: Effect Duration
Targets ModifierTarget.EFFECT_DURATION (MULTIPLY 0.1) - lengthens ordinary granted effects by 10%.
Modifier: Claim Chunk Cost
Targets ModifierTarget.CLAIM_CHUNK_COST (MULTIPLY -0.1) - reduces the point cost of claiming a chunk by 10%.
Modifier: Border Expansion Cost
Targets ModifierTarget.BORDER_EXPANSION_COST (MULTIPLY -0.1) - reduces the point cost of expanding your border by 10%.
Modifier: Better Contract Chance
Targets ModifierTarget.BETTER_CONTRACT_CHANCE (ADD 0.1) - improves your odds of being offered higher-value contracts.
Modifier: Better Effect Chance
Targets ModifierTarget.BETTER_EFFECT_CHANCE (ADD 0.1) - improves your odds of rolling better random effects.
Modifier: Shop Cost
Targets ModifierTarget.SHOP_COST (MULTIPLY -0.1) - reduces shop prices by 10%.
Modifier: Contract Refresh Cost
Targets ModifierTarget.CONTRACT_REFRESH_COST (MULTIPLY -0.1) - reduces the cost of manually refreshing your contract offers by 10%.
Modifier: Loss Refund
Targets ModifierTarget.DOUBLE_OR_NOTHING_LOSS_REFUND (ADD 0.1) - refunds 10% of your bet as points if you lose a Double Or Nothing gamble.
Modifier: Contract Completion Bonus
Targets ModifierTarget.CONTRACT_COMPLETION_MULT_PER_CONTRACT (ADD 0.001) - increases the multiplier bonus granted per completed contract.
